name: Mimi Pink
lede: Mimi Pink is a very pale, barely-there pink, one of the more obscure entries in Wikipedia's extended color lists.

sections.title: An obscure novelty name
sections.body:
Our library carries Mimi Pink only from Wikipedia's lists, flagged in our own data as an "obscure, qualified or novelty name," with no brand, person or place attached in the sources checked here [1]. Who coined it and when is undocumented [1].

Its nearest named neighbor by measured color is [[pink-lace]], a touch purpler, with [[queen-pink]], [[pale-pink]] and [[orchid-pink]] close behind [1]. At this pale a lightness, small shifts in screen calibration can move a swatch between several near-identical named pinks [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our archive finds a close match in only 2 of 23,781 paintings, 0.01 percent, as photographed; the within-painting lens finds it in 1 [2]. That makes it rarer than 86 percent of the named colors we track [2]. A pink this pale and this close to white is also one of the easiest shades for a photograph of an aged, varnished canvas to lose [2].
